title: Friends and Helpers
summary: "Friends and Helpers" by Sarah J. Eddy is a compilation aimed at teaching children about compassion and kindness toward animals, written in the late 19th century. After Rover escapes and is taken in by a caring family, he experiences love and warmth for the first time. As he learns to be useful by helping to herd sheep, the story emphasizes the significance of humane treatment and education in creating a better environment for both animals and humans.
